summary: Retest of iteration-12 frontend action items plus new UI E2E for office-driver linking and settlement-ownership visibility. All prior UX findings from iteration_12 are resolved on preview URL. In addition, one residual raw-i18n-key bug found and fixed in StatusBadge.jsx (kind='office' and kind='settlement' were building malformed keys like 'office.status_.pending' / 'fin.st_.pending' which produced raw keys in the badge). Office-driver linking end-to-end via UI works: office invites driver -> driver sees invite on /app/worker/profile via provider-card -> driver accepts -> office sees linked driver row. Settlements page renders without raw keys. Session isolation (sessionStorage isnad_token, empty localStorage) still confirmed on freshly-registered business account.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider gating /app/office/settlements + /app/office/drivers behind agreement acceptance to prevent premature access, though current state renders cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by tester: StatusBadge.jsx MAPS.office/settlement produced malformed i18n keys 'office.status_.pending' / 'fin.st_.pending' because ns already included the prefix while the render appended an extra '.' separator. Refactored to explicit {ns, prefix} pair and added a raw-key fallback (label === key ? status : label). This makes AdminOffices status chips render correctly in AR/EN/UR and also protects future settlement badges.
OnboardingBanner correctly falls back to raw status when translation missing (t(k) === k check). Business/Worker dashboards now mount OnboardingBanner as required (iteration_12 gap closed).
RequestNew.jsx correctly renders full-page wizard-blocked (with wizard-blocked-cta) for pending businesses before letting them enter the wizard - matches acceptance criterion.
Session isolation implementation still uses sessionStorage per tab; localStorage.getItem('isnad_token') confirmed null for freshly-registered user; backend sets no auth cookie by design.

rca of the issue: StatusBadge kind='office' had ns='office.status_' and code did t(`${ns}.${status}`) producing 'office.status_.pending' which is not a real translation path. i18n lookup splits by '.' so it walked ar.office.status_ (undefined) and returned the raw key. Same class of bug for kind='settlement' with ns='fin.st_'. Fix: split ns and prefix, then key = `${ns}.${prefix}${status}`; plus a defensive `label === key ? status : label` fallback.
